messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Alice Moreno <alice@atlasretail.com>
Date: Fri, May 1, 2026 at 3:10 PM -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + pilot suggestion

Hi Alice — thanks again for taking time today. Quick written recap from our call and a proposed next step so we can keep momentum. Attachment: redwood-discovery-recap.pdf

Key takeaways from today's demo/discovery:
- Goal: reduce inference cost for product recommendations while keeping 99th pct latency under 150ms for storefront traffic.
- Current stack: single-model endpoint on CPU during off-peak, GPU-based batch jobs for nightly scoring.
- Success metrics: 20–30% lower per-token cost for real-time paths; roll-forward to 5% of traffic in a pilot window.
- Constraints: SOC2 evidence request, data residency in us-west region, procurement timeline ~Q3.

Suggested next step: 2-week pilot (dedicated capacity, staging data subset, simple A/B for latency & cost). Proposed kickoff: 30–45 minute technical sync with your infra lead + our solutions engineer. If that's too big, we can do a 15-minute executive sync instead.

Available slots: https://cal.com/rachel-kim/15 — or tell me what works and I’ll book.

If this isn’t a fit, totally fine — one line back is helpful ("no" is okay).

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
(rachel.kim@redwood.com)
